content: Semantics of the aggregation NvBlockSwComponentType . bulkNvDataDescriptor The existence of an aggregation at meta-class NvBlock- SwComponentType in the role bulkNvDataDescriptor indicates that read-only ac- cess to a block of data in non-volatile memory shall be provided. Access to this block of data is provided directly from non-volatile memory as op- posed to via a RAM mirror.
